title: Lowell & Finch office options
brief: I'm the office manager at Lowell & Finch Accountants and the six partners will go through this on their laptops before Friday's meeting on 2026-11-06. Under "Where we stand": our lease on Canal Street ends on 2027-03-31, and we have 38 staff, of whom 24 now come in 3 days a week. Under "The three ways forward", as a table with yearly rent, one-off cost and risk: A, renew Canal Street for 5 years and refit, rent 212000 a year, refit 140000, risk of paying for 38 desks when only about 26 are used on a busy day; B, move to the Hartley Yard building, rent 168000 a year, move and fit-out 205000, risk that clients dislike the move, and 6 of the staff live more than an hour away; C, take a smaller floor on Canal Street for 120000 a year with 26 shared desks plus 4 meeting rooms booked by the hour, refit 90000, risk that peak days are crowded. Under "If we regret it", what would have to be undone: A, we are tied to the lease for 5 years with an exit fee of 6 months' rent; B, moving back would cost about 150000 and we would have given up Canal Street; C, we can take more floor later if the landlord has it, otherwise nothing. Under "Recommendation": C, because it saves 92000 a year against A and keeps the address; test the desk-sharing for 8 weeks before signing, starting 2026-11-16.

edit.request: Option C's rent is 126000 a year, so the saving against A is 86000, and the desk-sharing test starts on 2026-11-23 instead.
